about: The station catalog for OurWKRP creator showcases. A creator file lists the categories it uses (by id) and writes its own copy for each. A category may be used by no creator yet.

categories.name: Sound
categories.covers: music, DJ sets, listening rooms, podcasts recorded live

categories.name: Wear
categories.covers: merch, fashion, art objects, pop-up tables

categories.name: Lead
categories.covers: the operator's combined view across every station

categories.name: Spirit
categories.covers: faith, meditation, ritual and gathering practices
